owner_acceptance: Design research selections by Second Root owner; not merchant/client authorization

provenance.basis: Source case descriptions and prior recorded owner preferences; composition mappings are analysis, not measured causal facts

reuse_policy.allow: Reason about how shop-specific verified facts could inspire an original composition; require human selection

cases.name: Mond — The Living Archive
cases.structural_translation: Use typography as a structural plane; balance narrow/dense photography panels and quiet text areas in an uneven editorial layout
visual_mechanisms: oversized serif logotype embedded across image boundaries
unequal panels and overhanging imagery
fine rules, vertical captions, restrained neutral space

why_selected.statement: User submitted Mond as an exemplary design
Overlaps across panel boundaries and oversized lettering make an editorial identity distinct from generic cards

known_failure_modes: Replacing overlapping panels with repeatable left-text/right-image modules
cases.implementation_gap: No HTML PoC approved for this design

cases.name: Sissi — Flower is Art
cases.structural_translation: Let irregular branch paths determine the reading direction and whitespace shapes without imitating literal branch positions
visual_mechanisms: floating blossom imagery intersects logotype
organic trajectories and scale hierarchy
small editorial text on negative space

why_selected.statement: A was favored over B in previous comparisons
The motif actively shapes the structure instead of remaining a decorative photograph

known_failure_modes: Turning flowers into isolated grid cards
Using decorative curves unrelated to actual merchandise
cases.implementation_gap: No HTML PoC approved for this design

cases.name: なごやビーンズ — Editorial Roast Atlas v4
cases.structural_translation: Turn nine gradations of roast into an ascending visual atlas, then vary section rhythm instead of repeating the scale
visual_mechanisms: diagonal nine-bean spectrum
large type crosses material images
DEPTH/ROAST/YOUR CUP treated as separate visual beats

why_selected.statement: User explicitly approved v4 after rejecting more generic earlier full-page versions
Making the degree of roast a composition, not a card list, gives shop specificity

known_failure_modes: Repeating the nine-roast guide twice
Shrinking distinctive hero into conventional full-page product catalog
Generic symmetrical text/image alternation
not_to_copy: ROAST ATLAS copy as a brand slogan
cases.implementation_gap: Local browser PoC only; no Next.js verification or deployment

cases.name: harebare — Spinning Beigoma Editorial
cases.structural_translation: Translate spinning-top motion into orbital paths connecting typography, textures and product photography
visual_mechanisms: orbital trajectories across boundaries
oversized name colliding with cookie silhouettes
contrast of dark cast iron against warm baked goods

why_selected.statement: User positively evaluated and requested saving the result
A shop-specific physical motion helps the full-page composition stay expressive

known_failure_modes: Forcing the revolving-orbit motif on products with no relationship to rotation
cases.implementation_gap: Local browser PoC only, client clearance and production not verified

cases.name: Hamsa — Rice Koji / Shared Loaf Editorial
cases.structural_translation: A split loaf opens a window into place; irregular bread cross-sections and shared fragments become the shapes of editorial transitions
visual_mechanisms: large bread cross-section intersects name
circular architectural inset
torn paper outlines and overlapping food scenes

why_selected.statement: User selected the first concept's hero but the second concept's lower composition
User accepted refined hybrid and requested success storage

known_failure_modes: Re-generating the first draft unchanged instead of hybridizing
Repeating panoramic horizontal photo strips under a strong hero
Using low-resolution crops from a text-embedded composite as production photography
cases.implementation_gap: Local PoC rendered; imagery resolution weaker than design reference, no Next.js build/deployment

cases.name: Melon de Mille — CUT & STACK
cases.structural_translation: Use literal cut and stacking of fruit and pastry layers to inspire angled high-contrast graphic planes
visual_mechanisms: colossal cobalt sans typography
angled cutouts showing tart layers
green melon versus red berry and blue geometry

why_selected.statement: User selected B as the second of four directions and requested saving its refinement
Graphic collision of tart cross-section and oversized typography provides a different design family

known_failure_modes: Softening bold structure into conventional patisserie cards
Letting intense blue reduce readability or misrepresent a shop's actual character
not_to_copy: specific title typography and invented product details
cases.implementation_gap: No HTML/CSS PoC; mobile composition and real product validation pending

cases.name: ORGN. — SEAM / CUT Editorial
cases.structural_translation: Translate the shared notion of cutting and sewing into visual strokes and editorial seams linking distinct hair portraits, fabric details and shop sections; derive a unique layout rather than copying another brand
visual_mechanisms: separate hair and garment photo planes connected by fine graphic seams
angular patchwork and asymmetrical collage
real independent HTML typography and layered SVG strokes
different density of HAIR, REMAKE, STYLE and BOOK sections

why_selected.statement: User explicitly said 成功例とします about the ORGN. SEAM/CUT v1 local HTML PoC
Shop-specific actions (haircut and apparel remake) provide a coherent structural motif, not an unrelated visual decoration

known_failure_modes: Reusing giant brand-name typography from the Mond concept as the primary pattern instead of finding this salon's own visual principle
Substituting generic two-column salon image + text sections for the cut-and-stitch editorial structure
Mistaking AI-generated portraits or atelier interiors for authentic store/client photography
Assuming experimental CSS overlays work in the constrained production generator without verification
not_to_copy: ORGN. name, original branding and copy
exact thread paths or patchwork collage
AI-generated fashion model images or salon interiors
cases.implementation_gap: Local HTML/CSS/JS PoC only; browser checks on six widths reported, but Next.js, public deployment, real photography, accessibility and merchant review remain pending

cases.name: 整体院 Go. — PAUSE / GO
cases.structural_translation: Build a visual transition from compressed/dense typography and dark photographs into open cream space; keep the oversized GO. and fine yellow route-line as structure rather than using a generic wellness landing page.
visual_mechanisms: colossal GO. typography in charcoal-navy
cream/ink contrast with a single vivid yellow visual path
overlap between treatment imagery and graphic panels
varied editorial densities instead of repeating equal wave-photo bands

why_selected.statement: Owner initially liked the A concept but rejected a generic cream-and-green revision because it erased the huge GO. and yellow line
Owner said 成功例とします after a revision restored the accepted hero visual language and adjusted lower composition
Explicit protection of earlier accepted features improves iteration discipline; not proof of broader design outcomes

known_failure_modes: Removing the giant GO. typographic anchor during polishing
Replacing the distinctive yellow line and navy/cream contrast with generic wellness greens
Repeating wavy panoramic photo strips through lower sections
Mistaking a mobile mockup included in a static poster for a responsive website
Treating generated treatment or interior photos as authentic evidence of a real provider
not_to_copy: the GO. logo and exact typographic placement
the generated therapy imagery and invented copy
cases.implementation_gap: One owner-selected static editorial poster, containing a phone preview; no independent responsive HTML/CSS/JS PoC, build or public deployment

cases.name: 豆＊豆 — STITCH / TOGETHER editorial craft shop
shop_motifs: hand sewing and red connecting threads
cases.structural_translation: Translate round textile elements into a nonuniform constellation and stitched connections across the page; a red doorway anchors the visual arrival, while making and merchandise chapters use different photo sizes and visual rhythms.
visual_mechanisms: large Japanese typography on warm paper in a strong initial hero
unequal yo-yo circles integrated with shop-door photography
dotted red seam paths connecting distinct sections
close-up making process versus collage product details versus quilt mass
large red entrance as closing visual climax

why_selected.statement: User said いいと思います about first design, then requested refinement and HTML implementation that protects its hero
User explicitly approved the completed PC/mobile local PoC with 成功例として扱います
Craft-specific joining, fabric geometry and doorway create a readable page-wide principle distinct from bakery or salon layouts

known_failure_modes: Repeating identical round fabric collage in every chapter rather than changing image scale and information density
Discarding the already selected hero while polishing later sections
Using low-resolution crops from one generated poster in a finished production website
Presenting generated storefront, logo or products as certified real-store documentation
Calling an offline Chromium PoC fully deployed or cross-browser tested
not_to_copy: exact yo-yo fabric cutouts or thread trajectory
specific poster structure and asset colors
cases.implementation_gap: Local HTML/CSS/JS PoC checked at six viewport widths; no live deployment, Next.js build, true merchant images/approval, or high-resolution replacement for all crops.

limitations: Six initial cases were concentrated in food and floral categories; ORGN. and Seitai Go add salon/fashion and bodywork study examples
Five cases have local HTML PoCs; four remain concept/image-only; none are verified live production websites
User acceptance of a design is not confirmation of the causal mechanism inferred by analysis
Store photos and speculative text are research only; must not be sent as official representations
